lanterne.guide.hors_jeu: The illustrated guide opens once you are in game.
lanterne.guide.aide: space: play or stop · ← → : chapter · wheel: scrub · R: restart · Esc: close
lanterne.guide.portail.sol: A waypoint portal is built exactly like a Nether one, and at the same point in the game.
lanterne.guide.portail.cadre: An obsidian frame, two blocks wide by three tall at the very least. The size you already know.
lanterne.guide.portail.coeur: Swap one frame block for a Waypoint Heart. Only one, and never in a corner.
lanterne.guide.portail.coeur.note: The heart counts as obsidian: an existing Nether portal only needs one block changed.
lanterne.guide.portail.allumer: Light it with flint and steel, on the heart or inside the frame. The sheet takes the colour you give it.
lanterne.guide.portail.relier: Click the heart bare-handed: name it, tint it, open it to others, and choose where it leads.
lanterne.guide.portail.relier.note: The way back installs itself if the destination led nowhere.
lanterne.guide.portail.traverser: Walk through. Breaking the heart erases the portal — and the destinations others wrote down.
lanterne.guide.graveur.poser: The engraver is a machine: you craft it, you place it, it works.
lanterne.guide.graveur.charger: Slide a blank disc in, by clicking the block with the blank in hand.
lanterne.guide.graveur.graver: Click bare-handed: give it a link or a file, and the engraving starts.
lanterne.guide.graveur.graver.note: Six seconds. If anything fails, the blank comes back — always.
lanterne.guide.graveur.prendre: Click again to take the disc. It plays in any jukebox.
lanterne.guide.tableau.mur: A painting goes on a wall, just like in real life.
lanterne.guide.tableau.pinceau: Click the wall with the brush: a blank canvas hangs right away.
lanterne.guide.tableau.toile.note: No screen gets in the way: you see its footprint first, you fill it afterwards.
lanterne.guide.tableau.image: Click the canvas to open the studio, then pick the image by link, by file, or from the server library.
